recorded.prompt:q-vertex: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-vertex: "Stopping inside means the barrier's own answer is generally not a vertex: many variables sit just off their bounds." ... "Crossover can be switched off, and then the answer may have many more variables in between, all of them correct to the tolerance."
recorded.prompt:q-choose: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-choose: "each iteration only multiplies the constraint matrix (and its transpose) by a vector ... An iteration is cheap and needs no more memory than the matrix itself, so PDLP can take on LPs too big to factor." ... "simplex first, barrier when simplex is slow, PDLP when the LP is too large for either."
recorded.prompt:q-compare: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-compare: "**The tolerance is relative.** ... So the gap is divided by the size of the values." with `abs(a - b) / max(1, abs(a), abs(b)) <= 1e-6` as the check that "two objectives agree".

recorded.prompt:q-vertex:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vertex:a: "What both forms share is where they stop: on a vertex. At a vertex ... the few that do not (the **basic** variables) number at most one per row." With 12 rows, simplex can have at most 12 in between.
recorded.prompt:q-vertex:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vertex:c: Dual simplex "repairs broken rows one at a time, until none is broken."
recorded.prompt:q-vertex:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vertex:d: Barrier "moves through its interior toward the best vertex, keeping away from the walls until the end". Moving onto a vertex is crossover's job, and crossover is off here.
recorded.prompt:q-choose:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-choose:a: By the page's stated order, "PDLP when the LP is too large for either". Simplex has already failed here (still pivoting after a day). Partly true, though: the reason given (a pivot is cheaper than a factorization) matches "an iteration costs far more than a pivot".
recorded.prompt:q-choose:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-choose:b: Crossover is "a clean-up that moves the barrier's answer to a nearby optimal vertex", run after the barrier. Barrier still "has to factor a large matrix at every iteration ... that factorization is what runs out first."
recorded.prompt:q-choose:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-choose:d: Dual simplex "repairs broken rows one at a time, until none is broken." It does not skip rows.
recorded.prompt:q-compare:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:b: "**Rounding is not a fix.** 6,052,813.4 and 6,052,811.6 round to different whole numbers"
recorded.prompt:q-compare:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:c: "**The tolerance is relative.** A difference of 1.8 on six million is $`3 \times 10^{-7}`$; the same 1.8 on an objective of 50 would be a real disagreement."
recorded.prompt:q-compare:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:d: "PDLP's value is even *above* the true maximum ... On the large portfolio below its value lands below the maximum instead. Which side PDLP lands on is not fixed."
